g.text: Synthetic 500 s hot fires with throttle changes between 80 % and 109 % power level; six channels (two synchronous vibration levels, bearing-band and broadband vibration,
temperature, pressure). Learned detector: quadratic model of each channel against power level fitted on 40 normal runs, Mahalanobis distance of the residuals, smoothed
(EWMA), threshold set on 200 validation runs. Black line: failure. Faults: bearing wear growing exponentially (time constant 8–50 s); 8 % of runs contain a brief sensor
